name: Hayabusa
best_known_for: First asteroid sample ever returned to Earth (1500 μg from Itokawa, 2010); heroic recovery from multiple system failures
credit: Added with /fly mission JSON (#341 batch 5). Pioneer of asteroid sample-return + ion-propulsion for primary cruise. Successor Hayabusa 2 returned Ryugu sample 2020.
